Summary of problems and fixes:
- Price was stored as text in 3 rows (e.g., "$350.00"). Converted to numbers so averages can be computed.
- Date had 3 invalid entries ("TBD", "not-a-date", and one malformed date). These were set to missing so they do not break date-based checks.
- Region had two label variants: "North " (with trailing space) and "Suoth" (likely a misspelling of "South"). Both were merged into the allowed labels "North" and "South".
- Revenue was re-computed as Quantity × Price for all rows to ensure consistency, though it already matched in every row.
- No duplicates, missing values in key columns, or out-of-range quantities were found.
- All rows were kept; nothing was excluded.

Average unit price by category:
- Accessories: 37.14
- Electronics: 369.00
- Furniture: 169.17
- Office Supplies: 13.64

All numbers come directly from the cleaned data. Let me know if you want the same breakdown by month or by region.
